name: factory
description: Run herdr software factories through this session: it ticks every run, runs a hidden patrol subagent as its manager, and draws a live console.

autopilot.title: Let a hidden patrol subagent drive the factory
autopilot.description: On: a hidden patrol subagent patrols the factory, so the main chat stays free for you. It wakes on mail for the manager (a stuck station, a worker's question, a gate, a finished run), on a worker blocked on a prompt, and every 10 minutes while workers run or a rig with a goal has room, and acts on them. Off: mail only shows in the pane and a toast.
